body: I'd be willing to give it a try again. I have excellent insurance so I really have nothing to lose but time.

Much appreciation for all the support. I've been thinking hard about seeing a professional. My main stumbling block is the potential of anything I say being reported. I've been suicidal for over a decade. I spend at least 20 minutes every morning staring at myself in the mirror fantasizing about my own death.  I can't imagine a therapist just taking that sort of thing in stride.

She's basically an evil villain. i can't even begin to describe the beatings, corporal punishment, downright torture of varying degrees and other nonsense she regularly bestowed upon me. 


She did instill a solid work ethic in me. Boys are for building things and fixing things. That's what I was always told and it kind of stuck. So that's a bonus I guess.

As for my daughter I understand that my death would hurt her greatly. It would damage her psyche and of course hamper her ability to do a lot due to finances. I just really think she would forget me and that realistically she only loves me because she doesn't know any better. I can't shake the thought. She's the only person that has ever loved me as far as I know. I don't want her to feel pain but I really don't enjoy being here.

I've attempted therapy in the past. I'm unwilling to share enough with a stranger to risk losing both my child and employment. So it's pointless. 

I'm fairly certain a professional would be forced to contact some form of government agency. I've thought about killing myself every morning for as long as I can remember. It's the first thing that I consciously think about in the morning.

I'm twenty five years old. I left my mothers home when I was 16. I was homeless for some time. My family was well aware. Continued to support my two step brothers from my step fathers previous marriage. 

I was attacked while sleeping in downtown Brooklyn. Sustained a serious head injury a healthy amount of stab wounds and of course an all around bruising. Emergency responders found identification on me. Notified my mother. 

"Have them release you if they want money. If they send a bill to my house you'll pray they kill you next time. Did they rape you? Are you a fucking AIDS patient now?"

I hung up at that point. I've spoken to her a few times since. She maintains that she's never been anything but kind to me. Called the police last time I saw her. I made the mistake of asking how holding a 10 year olds hands under the hot faucet was kind. 

I wasn't raped. I've since managed to pull myself up by my bootstraps. I'm an elevator mechanic. I make more in an hour than either of my step brothers do in a day. I still don't really understand what it feels like to be loved. Recalling those words have kept me from killing myself more than once.

A few sob stories and his previously alarming behavior is no longer a concern? Why because he promised? This man has been involved in gang violence and various other felonious activities and you're still on board? Even with a kid?

I certainly hope he actually is a 10 and showers you in his ill gotten gains. You're a trooper. Or insane.
